notes: Best: settled on the health-as-ammo idea. Worst: figuring out how to make the mechanic create an actual trade-off.
Best: got the basic shooting and health systems working. Worst: fixing Odin syntax and getting the generated code to fit the existing project.
Best: enemies could chase and damage the player. Worst: collision and dynamic array removal caused bugs.
Best: the health orb loop made the game feel different from ARENA. Worst: getting expired or collected orbs to remove safely.
Best: added the runner enemy and increasing difficulty. Worst: balancing the health cost of shooting against the amount of healing from orbs.
Best: seeing other people play helped identify balance issues. Worst: some players spent too much time trying to collect orbs while enemies were nearby.
Best: added clearer health and survival information. Worst: testing edge cases around losing and restarting.
Best: repeated playtesting exposed problems that were not obvious from reading the code. Worst: some suggested fixes solved one issue while creating another.
Best: got the final game into a playable state with win, loss, and restart. Worst: checking all the submission requirements took longer than expected.
